crossRefs.note: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but…
that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is…
For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit…
Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the…
But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil…
For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be…
Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil…
instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly…
Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but…
Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection…

translations.web: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
translations.bsb: For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
translations.kjv: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
translations.asv: for if ye live after the flesh, ye must die; but if by the Spirit ye put to death the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
